{{Quote|Leia doesn't know this, but I've got them programmed for some good, greasy Corellian sausages.|Han Solo|<ref name="Firestorm" />}}
'''Corellian sausages''' were a type of [[Sausage/Legends|sausage]],<ref name="Firestorm" /> from the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] delivered supplies to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] burgeoning [[Jedi Praxeum]], including [[Food synthesizer/Legends|food preparation units]], he made sure they were programmed to make Corellian sausages. The sausages were known to be greasy.<ref name="Firestorm" />
